dish_return_cycle.title: Dish return cycle
dish_return_cycle.caption: Lift the top white plate from the stack beside the green bus tub on the pot sink landing. Turn the plate upright, seat it between the pegs of the grey plate rack beside the hood dishwasher and let go. Raise the dishwasher hood, align the loaded rack with the opening and slide it inside. Lower the hood, then raise it again. Move the rack onto the outlet table with the plate still standing. Lift the plate out, lay it flat on the stack farthest from the dishwasher on the drying shelf above the outlet table, and let go. Recorded in the simulator; no robot hand is shown.

fridge_door.title: Fridge door
fridge_door.caption: At the two-door reach-in fridge, open the door farthest from the refrigerated counter. Hold it open briefly. Swing it back against its frame, let go and check that it stays closed. Recorded in the simulator; no robot hand is shown.

tub_slide.title: Tub slide
tub_slide.caption: Find the empty green bus tub on the landing beside the pot sink. Push it straight along the landing, away from the stack of white plates and toward the outer end. Release it and let it stop upright on the landing. Recorded in the simulator; no robot hand is shown.

prerinse_spray.title: Prerinse spray
prerinse_spray.caption: At the prerinse unit over the pot sink, turn the spray nozzle clear of its hook, then swing the hose arm over the basin. Open the hot tap and close it again. Swing the arm back, park the nozzle on the same hook and let go. Recorded in the simulator; no robot hand is shown.

basket_return.title: Basket return
basket_return.caption: Lift the wire cooking basket out of the boiler unit until the basket clears its rim. Carry it along the cooking line to the stainless corner worktable, set it on the worktop and let it come to rest upright. Recorded in the simulator; no robot hand is shown.

stock_pot_to_burner.title: Stock pot to burner
stock_pot_to_burner.caption: On the pan shelving across from the prep counter, take the stock pot on the bottom shelf closest to both the prep counter and the dish-return line. Pull it clear of the shelf, lift it and carry it around the dish-return end of the prep counter. Lower it onto the back burner nearest the boiler unit on the range with ovens. Let go and leave the pot level and still. Recorded in the simulator; no robot hand is shown.
